note: Edges: snell and pinhole-ratio are existing atlas nodes; eye-vision is a new concept id.

description.zh: 把眼睛简化成薄透镜加视网膜：调节改变屈光力使像回到视网膜；眼轴偏长焦点落在网膜前是近视，凹透镜（P < 0）矫正，远视相反；瞳孔越小景深越大。简约眼模型，非验光建议。
description.en: A reduced eye is a thin lens plus a retina: accommodation changes the lens power to bring the image back onto the retina; an axis that is too long puts the focus in front of the retina (myopia), corrected by a concave lens (P < 0), and hyperopia is the opposite; a smaller pupil gives a larger depth of field. A reduced-eye model, not an eye test.

label.zh: 折射让晶状体会聚光线
label.en: Refraction lets the lens converge light

reason.zh: 晶状体的会聚作用来自光在曲面界面上的折射；曲率越大屈光力越强，这就是调节的物理基础。
reason.en: The lens converges light by refraction at curved interfaces; more curvature means more power, which is the physical basis of accommodation.

label.zh: 小瞳孔像小孔一样增加景深
label.en: A small pupil acts like a pinhole and deepens the field

reason.zh: 同样的失焦，孔径越小模糊斑越小：瞳孔缩小就像小孔成像一样，让更大范围的物距都显得清晰。
reason.en: For the same defocus a smaller aperture gives a smaller blur spot; a constricted pupil acts like a pinhole and keeps a wider range of distances looking sharp.

title.zh: 为什么近视要戴凹透镜？
title.en: Why does short-sightedness need a concave lens?

ask.zh: 近视是眼轴偏长，焦点落在视网膜前还是后？要把焦点往后推，该用会聚光的透镜还是发散光的透镜？
ask.en: In short-sightedness the eyeball is too long, so does the focus fall in front of or behind the retina? To push it back, do you need a converging or a diverging lens?

ask.zh: 光从空气进入透镜会折射——凹透镜让光发散还是会聚？发散之后焦点往哪个方向移？
ask.en: Light refracts entering a lens — does a concave lens spread light out or bring it together? And which way does spreading move the focus?

reveal.zh: 近视焦点在视网膜前，凹透镜把光发散开，焦点后移到视网膜上；远视正好相反。
reveal.en: In short-sightedness the focus lands in front of the retina; a concave lens spreads the light so the focus shifts back onto the retina. Long-sightedness is the reverse.
